rationale: Independent reading: EO 9204 (7 FR 5657) designates the Secretary of the Interior as Fishery Coordinator, creates the Office of Fishery Coordination, sets its functions (incl. agency liaison officers reporting to the Office) and staffing, and sec. 4 runs 'so long as Title I of the First War Powers Act, 1941, remains in force'. Held EO 9649 (10 FR 13431, Oct. 29, 1945), under the same authority: 'The Office of Fishery Coordination ..., established pursuant to Executive Order No. 9204 ..., together with the office of Fishery Coordinator, is terminated', with wind-up only. Every operative provision of EO 9204 depends on the Office or Coordinator, so nothing remains in operation. EO 9204 is not named as revoked; the NO rests on termination of all its subject institutions, which I agree supports a provisional NO; the precise legal end date stays a lifecycle gap.
